Definition: to crowd; also to gash (as if by pressing into)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to penetrate, cut, attack, invade; 1a) (Qal) to penetrate, cut into; 1b)(Hithpoel); 1b1) to cut oneself; 1b2) to gather in troops or crowds
